snippet.title: The Mighty Claw, Steam Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Download The Mighty Claw demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386380/The_Mighty_Claw/

In The Mighty Claw, you get to explore a colorful 2D cartoon world with the help of the titular Mighty Claw grappling hook, unleash your inner grappler and get ready to swing, spin, grab and throw!

The Mighty Claw presents you an environment that allows room for creativity and lets you discover dozens of different ways to use your Claw. Whether it’s gaining speed, crossing gaps, chaining swings like crazy, tossing your enemies around or stretching gigantic guinea pigs by pulling their bottoms, the Claw is your number one tool for the task! You can use your Claw to countless different targets, whether it’s wall, ceiling, an unsuspecting mad scientist owl or a tornado sneezed out of congested nose.

The cartoony world of the game is filled with a lot of fascinating stuff to discover, as well as a cast of more or less ridiculous characters. As the village of our young hero gets invaded by a megalomaniac conqueror, his chronically-bored pet elephant and his army of totally incompetent troops, our hero comes across the mysterious Claw. Accompanied by his newly-found power of grappling, our hero sets out on a journey to free different areas occupied by the conqueror.
